最近更新内容于 Open WebUI
更新日志
v0.13.5
v0.13.5
Nov 25, 2026
ADDED
Folder workspaces. Run your project’s tests in a terminal and try the app in a browser while your chat stays open beside them. Choose the computer and project directory once for the folder. Even in a shared folder, everyone can return to their own tabs and layout. If you used the standalone Open WebUI Computer (cptr) app, that workflow is now built into Open WebUI. #34804, #34805, #34800, #34803
Project instructions and skills. Tell the assistant how your project works once in an AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md file. Every new chat in that project folder reads those instructions. Connect the project machine with Open Terminal 0.18.0 or later and the assistant can also follow reusable project instructions called skills, run checks in your terminal and inspect the result in your browser tab.
Long chat performance. Sending a message was 34× faster in our 130 MB PostgreSQL test chat. The server accepted it in 0.32 seconds, down from 10.9, because it now saves just the messages that changed. Database writes fell from 533 MB to 2 KB per message. #34689, #34671, #34688, #34672, #34674, #34670, #34646
Automatic model selection. Put one router in the chat’s model picker and it can send coding questions to one model and writing requests to another. Admins choose text patterns or describe the kind of question each model should handle. If nothing matches, the router uses the first model on its list or picks one at random. #34900, #34895, #34791, #34796, #34908, #34662, #34956, #34957, #34887, #34786, #34793, #34897, #34898, #34466, #15996
Citations beside the chat. Hover over a source number for a quick excerpt, or click it to read the evidence beside the answer. You can compare passages from the same document, see how closely they match your question and jump to the cited PDF page when page information is available. #34923, #34836, #34921, #34828, #34831, #34832, #34833, #34913, #34834, #34829, #20829
Steer a coding agent while it works. If Codex or Claude Code starts editing the wrong file, send a correction in the same chat. The coding agent can act on a text follow-up while the job is running. A follow-up with attachments waits for the next turn so the agent receives the instruction and files together.
Recurring tasks can continue a conversation. Schedule a morning status report in the same chat or channel thread each day. The automation reads the replies people added since its last run, so today’s report can account for a decision someone posted yesterday afternoon. #33731
Use a remote computer from chat. Connect a workstation over SSH, the same secure connection you use to log in remotely, and work with its files and command-line tools from chat. This setup requires Open Terminal 0.17.21 or later and su
